title: When something is inhibiting "shutdown" using systemd-inhibit, shutting down and rebooting from the GUI fail silently
line: When an app like zypper blocks shutdown, the logout screen and a notification now say which app is blocking it, instead of closing the session and silently failing.
explanation: plasma-shutdown always closed the whole session (apps, plasmashell, KWin) and only then asked logind to power off or reboot. When a block inhibitor such as zypper's was active, logind refused with OperationInhibited and nothing told the user; they were left on a black screen with the computer still on. The logout screen also offered Shut Down / Restart and counted down to them with no hint of the block. The MRs make plasma-shutdown check logind's inhibitors before closing the session and, if blocked, keep the session and send a 'Cannot Shut Down'/'Cannot Restart' notification naming the apps and their reasons; the logout screen shows the same text, hides Shut Down/Restart and stops the countdown.

commits.message:
session: Report shutdown inhibitors before closing the session

When a block inhibitor stopped shutdown or restart, the whole session was
closed first and the power action then failed with no message. Check the
inhibitors first, keep the session running and notify which apps block it.

BUG: 523719

logout: Show programs inhibiting shutdown

The logout screen offered Shut Down and Restart and counted down to them
even while a program blocked them, so the action failed silently. Show the
programs and their reasons instead, and hide those buttons and the timer.

BUG: 523719

media.caption: Master: with zypp holding a block shutdown inhibitor, the logout screen counts down to Shut Down with no hint; pressing it closed the whole session and PowerOff was then refused silently
With the MRs: the logout screen says 'zypp is currently blocking shutdown: Zypp commit running.', no countdown, only Cancel
Shut Down without the confirmation screen (plasma-shutdown called directly): the session stays and a 'Cannot Shut Down' notification names zypp and its reason
Full logout screen under the same block: Sleep, Hibernate, Log Out and Cancel remain, with the blocking app shown
Restart under the same block: 'Cannot Restart' notification

review.text: Checking logind's inhibitors before closing the session, then notifying and keeping the session, addresses the real cause. The greeter also hides Shut Down/Restart and stops the countdown. These are the open MRs plasma-workspace!7184 and plasma-desktop!4061, and the rig run covers block and delay inhibitors and both actions. The change is large (systemd ≥257 owner-block heuristics, and SessionManagement's Ready now waits up to 500 ms for the inhibitor query), and pulling plasma-shutdown strings into ksmserver.pot through Messages.sh is unusual, but these are design points for the MR reviewers, not defects. Sleep blocked by an inhibitor is still silent, as the notes say.
